assets.name: rubber-duck
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single fixed transparent prop for a tiny 280x240 animation. Subject: one charming classic yellow rubber duck, whole duck in left-facing side view, plump rounded body and raised head, a small coral orange beak, one simple dark plum dot eye, a tiny sculpted wing. Style: polished warm storybook gouache with a thick warm plum outline, clean bold silhouette, subtle paper grain and cream highlights, readable at 70-100 pixels. Palette honey yellow, golden ochre, coral orange and warm plum, no blue. Composition centered, generous transparent margin, no perspective distortion, no ground, no cast shadow, no spring or accessories. Genuinely transparent background clean alpha. No lettering, watermark, logos, robots, other objects.
assets.selection: Original alpha preserved; no source edits. Fixed source reused for every frame.
